purpose: Current-source, validation-only paired Solar H96 comparison between the compact variable-axis Mamba and TimeMixer.
research_question: Does the existing Solar H96 variable-axis Mamba signal remain non-inferior to TimeMixer under one source snapshot and fresh paired seeds?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory matrix. No held-out test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: The matrix can establish only same-source validation and fixed-shape forward-resource evidence. It cannot establish held-out accuracy, universal superiority, or an independent causal AutoCon effect.

required_before_launch: verify the SolarEnergy fingerprint and six-job coverage
freeze model, baseline, optimizer, normalization, and seed contracts
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job
create one immutable source snapshot and fresh output roots

selection_contract.freeze_rule: All model, baseline, training, data, and seed settings are fixed before launch.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: Both arms share the Solar loader, chronological split, M features, input length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epoch budget, patience, and seeds.
capacity_fairness_contract.candidate: One variable-axis Mamba-1 scan with prediction-connected AutoCon representation fusion and train-only relation loss at lambda=.0001.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline: TimeMixer receives no AutoCon, relation, variable-axis Mamba, or representation-fusion setting.

phases.name: variable_candidate_timemixer_validation
phases.purpose: Compact variable-axis Mamba with fixed representation fusion and active relation objective.

phases.name: timemixer_baseline_validation
phases.purpose: TimeMixer external baseline under the common Solar budget.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Report all paired deltas. A held-out test release requires a separately frozen and explicitly approved plan.

stopping_rules: Reject the readout if any job is incomplete, source snapshots differ, or a test artifact exists.
Do not promote the candidate if it is not non-inferior to TimeMixer or if it is slower on the matched resource benchmark.
Do not claim an independent contrastive-loss causal contribution from this fixed-fusion matrix.
